annotations.title: Flag what you like in a reference

description: Saves which parts of a style reference the person likes (hook, edit, graphics, captions, music, sound effects) and the project it's kept under, or puts that question on their Home with ask_on_home when you don't know. Copy only the flagged parts when you write their version.

ask_on_home.description: Put a question on their Home asking which parts they like; their picks are saved on the reference for you

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

likes.description: The parts the person likes and wants to copy; saved on the reference's note

project.description: The project to keep it under, in their words (e.g. Daily reps); style_references_list shows it as saved_in

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: style_reference_flag
